text:
erin: CedarBridge sent an RFI. They want a 4-week POC, EU-only data residency, HSM BYOK, and a desktop VM for integration tests. Any blockers?

sam: quick sizing Q: expected throughput? tokens per req?

erin: they said ~120 req/min, avg 300 tokens, occasional bursts to 500 req/min. model: open chat model, prefer 8-bit quant if possible.

tom: we can do 8-bit in slim-runtime. For HSM BYOK we support KMIP adapters. Need vendor list and whether customer HSM can be reached from our control plane or require local connector.

erin: they insist no control-plane egress for model traffic; control plane only for billing/ops. offline demo VM ok?

tom: yes — provide offline demo image + local key adapter. We'll disable telemetry for the VM. KV persistence must be disk-backed for warm restarts.

legal: flag: DPA addendum + EU data routing clause required. Also need vendor attestation for supported HSMs. I'll draft a short DPA fragment.

sam: pricing options to propose: (1) Hosted metered POC, (2) Dedicated short reserve in EU, (3) Appliance-style license for on-prem VM. Back-of-envelope numbers pls.

erin: buyer wants line items for procurement by tomorrow morning.

tom: quick EoE:
- Hosted (metered): ~$1,900/month for their profile (variable).
- Dedicated reserve (4 weeks): ~$10,500 upfront (reserved pod) + $1,200 support.
- Appliance license (one-time): $9,000 + $2,500 integration.
Assumptions: 120 rpm avg, 300 tokens/req, quantized 8-bit.

sam: add a short "operational target" statement for latency: p95 < 400ms on dedicated pod; not a contractual SLA.

legal: will add acceptance criteria and failure modes to SOW. Need procurement contact to send NDA and DPA.

erin: contact is julia@cedarbridge.example. I'll request NDA now.

deploy-bot: Demo image build queued (cedar-vm-452). Tag: redwood/slim:edge-2026-03. Telemetry disabled. ETA ~75m.

tom: I'll prepare a one-page capability CSV and a short runbook snippet for their infra team (VLAN/CIDR + healthcheck curl).

erin: please drop the CSV and the security snippet in Drive. I'll assemble the RFI packet and email Julia tomorrow 08:30 CET. Thanks team :thumbsup:

legal: DPA draft ETA EOD.

erin: closing loop  - will update when demo ready (deploy-bot).
